objective: Restore real latest Wall comment content (avatar, name, body and time) instead of an oversized generic comment-count placeholder, preserving safe scoped access, media paint and fast navigation.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: current GitHub main source was inspected at 63ccd4b58ff02ff3c1535a1e05d3097fa8323c61 and this branch was forked directly from main, not from a verified live device. Read-only BUKLOD Connect Supabase inspection confirmed real visible comments and authorized preview RPC. This DEV source has no production runtime proof, APK verification or OTA readback.
chosenApproach: Reuse existing real preview component; batch authenticated comment RPC with RLS-protected fallback, decouple 4s metadata cutoff, preserve comments on transient refresh and update per post after send; no backend migration or new native dependencies.
preserveBehaviors: Keep the existing first-paint fast Wall and complete photo collage/video players without blocking on comments.
Preserve exact per-post comment sheet navigation, reactions, share, report, profile avatars and accessibility.
Protect all scope privacy via existing auth.uid, can_view_community_post_v2 and RLS; do not expose hidden or deleted comments.
Preserve AdMob preload, ad presentation, fast tab navigation, Expo runtime 1.3.2, and no IGPAT revival.
acceptanceChecks: Real commenter name/avatar/body/time display when a preview exists; never show generic oversized fake recent-comment text.
Only already visible authorized post IDs are queried; authenticated batch fallback on errors or missing results.
No 4-second cutoff discards late actual previews; stale load and account scope responses never affect new rows.
No meaningful rerender when preview contents remain the same; comments update after successful new comment.
New and existing relevant focused tests pass along with required engineering, CI and RC release gates.
Source-only candidate; do not publish staging or production OTA without independent required acceptance and exact runtime verification.

releaseTarget: DEV review only; not a production release
selectionRationale: Restore the actual comment using the already deployed, scope-authorized comment preview RPC and existing UI component. Keep data asynchronous so Wall photos, ads and navigation remain responsive; correct only the visible preview/late metadata regression instead of rewriting the feed.
alternativeApproaches: Leave the fake comment-count box: rejected because it hides the real discussion and does not meet the owner intent.
Block first paint until all comments load: rejected due to mobile network, navigation and media performance regressions.
Add per-post privileged or service-role comment fetching: rejected to preserve privacy/RLS and avoid extra calls.
